LanguageData.LP_DNDAlchemy.label: DND alchemy
LanguageData.LP_DNDAlchemy.description: Apply the alchemy of Faerûn to the Rim: brew potions from troll blood, herbs and more, and psionic suppressants that hold down psionic parasites. Unlocks the alchemy table and distillery (an attachment beside the alchemy table, speed +15%).
LanguageData.LP_MythicMetallurgy.label: mythic smelting
LanguageData.LP_MythicMetallurgy.description: Learn to work the two legendary metals mithril and adamantine, and temper cold iron with silver at the alchemy table. Mythic metals can be used as metal materials for all kinds of gear.
LanguageData.LP_Research_MythicDrilling.label: mythic deep mining
LanguageData.LP_Research_MythicDrilling.description: Combine vanilla deep drilling with mythic smelting: carve gold-seeking runes on the drill rod, guide it with a silver probe, and drill mithril and adamantine out of the deep crust. Unlocks the mythic deep drill (powered like a deep drill, operated as mining work, needs no deep deposits).
LanguageData.LP_Research_RuneSmithing.label: rune forging
LanguageData.LP_Research_RuneSmithing.description: The secrets of the dwarven forge: build rune anvils and rune quenching troughs. Subduing weapons and runic prosthetics are made on the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Scribing.label: scroll copying
LanguageData.LP_Research_Scribing.description: Learn to transcribe spells onto parchment: build the scroll desk and copy scrolls of true seeing, protection from evil and fireball; adventurer's manuals, golem manuals and scrolls of remove curse are also written at the desk. Researchers can identify items at the desk (50% faster than at the research bench).
LanguageData.LP_Research_HighScrolls.label: advanced scrolls
LanguageData.LP_Research_HighScrolls.description: Scrolls only an archmage dares to write: copy scrolls of teleportation (mithril), flesh to stone (adamantine) and revivify (miracle fragment) at the scroll desk.
LanguageData.LP_Research_NetherilArcana.label: Netherese arcana
LanguageData.LP_Research_NetherilArcana.description: Study the arcane system left by the fallen Netherese flying cities: unlocks the Netherese altar. Once this research is done and a colonist has read a Netherese scroll, Larloch the Shadow King will take notice of you.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Enchanting.label: enchantment
LanguageData.LP_Research_Enchanting.description: The basic lessons of sealing magic into metal and gems: unlocks the enchanting table, where you can make rings of protection, rings of free action, necklaces of adaptation and goggles of night; scrolls of remove curse are copied at the scroll desk. Researchers can identify unidentified items at the research bench or scroll desk, seeing through curses.
LanguageData.LP_Research_WondrousCraft.label: wondrous item crafting
LanguageData.LP_Research_WondrousCraft.description: The famous wondrous items from the Dungeon Master's Guide: gauntlets of ogre power, gloves of missile snaring, bracers of archery and defense, helm of telepathy, eyes of the eagle, eyes of minute seeing, periapt of wound closure, ring of spell turning, ring of regeneration, ring of spell storing, brooch of shielding and psionic hood, all made at the enchanting table. Unlocks the arcane focus stone (an attachment beside the enchanting table and scroll desk, speed +15%).
LanguageData.LP_Research_SacredRelics.label: relic consecration
LanguageData.LP_Research_SacredRelics.description: Consecrate protective relics at the altar: prayer beads, scarab of protection, purifying seals, circlet of holy light and rings of protective vows.
LanguageData.LP_Research_WondrousDevices.label: wondrous devices
LanguageData.LP_Research_WondrousDevices.description: Magic devices that aren't worn: immovable rod, decanter of endless water, everburning torch, horn of valhalla (made at the enchanting table).
LanguageData.LP_Research_GolemManual.label: golemancy
LanguageData.LP_Research_GolemManual.description: Study how to call stone into servitude: a lich can write a golem manual at the scroll desk, and after reading it make stone golem seeds at the necromantic ritual table.
LanguageData.LP_Research_GearEnhancing.label: gear enhancement
LanguageData.LP_Research_GearEnhancing.description: Layer magic onto weapons and apparel already made: pick an enhancement target on a weapon or garment, and the enchanting table's "enchant (+1 to +5)" bill will enhance it level by level with mithril and silver. Each level gives weapons +6% damage and +1.5% ranged hit, apparel +5% armor plus 1%, and +15% value; a successful enhancement also repairs durability. The higher the level, the more likely to fail; failure only loses the materials.
LanguageData.LP_Research_GearEnhancingHigh.label: advanced enhancement
LanguageData.LP_Research_GearEnhancingHigh.descriptio: Push gear from +5 on to +10: the enchanting table's "enchant (+6 to +10)" bill uses adamantine and gold instead. Lower success; failure from +6 upward drops the gear one level (never below +5).
LanguageData.LP_Research_Faith.label: faith and divine magic
LanguageData.LP_Research_Faith.description: Build altars per the teachings of Faerûn's gods: choose the colony's patron deity, pray, make offerings and craft holy symbols. Unlocks patron deity statues (an attachment beside the altar: altar speed +10%, prayer recreation +20%). Those wearing holy symbols can spend divine favor to cast divine magic.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Planetouched.label: celestial and infernal bloodlines
LanguageData.LP_Research_Planetouched.description: Study the celestial and infernal bloodlines of aasimar and tieflings. Once done, the choosing ritual can also change a believer's xenogenes to aasimar (good god) or tiefling (evil god). Aasimar and tieflings in factions don't need this research.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Theogony.label: theurgy
LanguageData.LP_Research_Theogony.description: Study how mortals absorb divine sparks and ascend to godhood: unlocks the "path of ascension" (saint, demigod lich, titan awakening, usurper) and the ascension ritual.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Subduing.label: subduing tactics
LanguageData.LP_Research_Subduing.description: The art of taking them alive: make subduing cudgels, net crossbows and slumber shortbows at the rune anvil, and slumber staves at the enchanting table. These weapons only knock targets unconscious, causing no wounds and never killing. With Ideology installed you can also make anesthetic slave collars at the machining table.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Abyssology.label: abyssology
LanguageData.LP_Research_Abyssology.description: Study the true names, habits and summoning rituals of abyssal demons. Unlocks the abyssal circle, binding circle, exorcism ward and planar anchor chain. At first the abyssal circle can only summon tier 1 manes swarms and quasits; tier 2 and above need demonology tomes: you must first read the tome recording that demon (from abyssal whispers events, Thayan Red Wizard relics and exotic traders).
LanguageData.LP_Banking.label: banking
LanguageData.LP_Banking.description: Learn the Sword Coast merchant guild's ways: iron-barred counters, underground vaults and the rules of bookkeeping. Unlocks the bank: a 2×2 vault that only takes silver and gold, 20 stacks per cell.
